classification: product log presentation and focused test coverage
root_cause: The unified command drain logged every native line at INFO and exposed stdout/stderr as the prominent label. Native warnings/errors, pipeline failure summaries and filesystem failure summaries could therefore be wrapped in INFO.

reproduction.scope: Actual full CLI with temporary mysql/xtrabackup executables plus real subprocess channel/severity cases. Baseline rc1 is expected rejection of the old presentation, not a database lifecycle result.

changes: Preserve redacted native text and display emitting command plus phase; retain channel on the LogRecord for diagnostics.
Recognize explicit native severity headers on either channel; do not match ERROR inside table/file names. Unknown severity remains informational and does not imply success.
Report filesystem failures and nonzero replay status summaries at ERROR. Keep existing return-code enforcement, metadata privacy, heartbeat, pipe drainage and child cleanup.
Wire both command-observability and XtraBackup streaming contracts into the fixed preflight; update the existing manual and pending matrix item.

validation.syntax_schema_import_boundary: Fixed preflight includes Python compile/import boundary and matrix validation; bash -n and git diff --check passed.
cases: stdout and stderr severity independence, timestamped Note/ERROR, mysql Warning/ERROR, FATAL, legacy timestamp, table/file ERROR false positives
real CLI terminal and file output before exit, redaction and complete backup fixture marker
native text cannot override zero or nonzero process status
pipeline emitter identity, both failure summaries, large output, metadata privacy, timeout/SIGINT and child reaping
file-stage heartbeat and ERROR on interruption/failure

source_review.python: Read local CPython logging.Logger.log/_log: level is explicit and independent of subprocess channels; snapshot retained. Python 3.6 logging/subprocess official documentation was accessible.
